def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    best=None
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if not grid[r][c]: continue
            rings=[]
            for d in range(1,min(r,c,h-1-r,w-1-c)+1):
                pts=[(y,x) for y in range(r-d,r+d+1) for x in range(c-d,c+d+1) if max(abs(y-r),abs(x-c))==d]
                counts=Counter(grid[y][x] for y,x in pts if grid[y][x]!=0)
                if not counts: break
                col,n=counts.most_common(1)[0]
                if n<len(pts)-1: break
                holes=[(y,x) for y,x in pts if grid[y][x]==0]
                if len(holes)!=1: break
                y,x=holes[0]
                direction=0 if y==r-d else 1 if x==c+d else 2 if y==r+d else 3
                rings.append((col,direction))
            if best is None or len(rings)>len(best[2]): best=(r,c,rings)
    r,c,rings=best
    d=len(rings)
    markers=[(y,x) for y in range(h) for x in range(w) if grid[y][x] and max(abs(y-r),abs(x-c))>d]
    same=[p for p in markers if grid[p[0]][p[1]]==grid[r][c]]
    if same: markers=same
    y,x=markers[0]
    target=(1 if x>c else 3) if abs(x-c)>abs(y-r) else (2 if y>r else 0)
    return [[col]*((target-dr)%4)+[0]*(3-(target-dr)%4) for col,dr in rings]
